To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1-azacycloalkanes with the homoadmantane fragment can be obtained in high yields from the readily available starting materials by carbocationic intramo-lecular cyclization.
trifluoromethylsulfonic acid transforms 1-[2-adamantan-1-ylethyl]-1,2-dihydropyridines into 1-azacyclopent[3.1.1.0(3,8)]heptanes annulated with the adamantane fragment.
trifluoromethylsulfonic acid transforms 1-[2-adamantanyl-2-hydroxy-ethyl]-1, 2, 3, 6-tetrahydro-pyridines into 1-azabi-cyclo[3.3, 1]non-4-enes with the homoadmantane framework.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of 1-azaspiro[4.4]nonanes and 1-azadispiro[3.3]nonanes containing the homoadamantan-1-amine fragment.
the synthesis of a new type of heteroannulated bicyclic compounds containing the homoadamantan-1-one fragment.
the synthesis of new homoadamantanes and their transformations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the reaction of 1-[adamantan-1-yloxycarbonyl]-2-oxoethanols with pyridines in the presence of trifluorosulfonic acid is an effective method for the preparation of 1-azaspiro[4.5]decane derivatives with the adamantane fragment.
the reaction of 1-[1-[(1-Adamantyl)ethyl]-1,3-dihydro-2H-pyridin-2-yl]ethanols 1a-c with trifluoromethylsulfonic acid leads to the formation of 1-azatricyclo[3.3,1.0]non-3-ene 2a-c.

1-[2- (adamantan-1-y1)-2-hydroxylethyl]-1,2.3.6-tetrahydro- pyridines undergo carbocationic rearrangements with the formation of 1-azabi- cyclo[3.3,1]non- 3-enes annelated with the homoadmantane framework.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the transformation of 1-[3-(adamantan-1-yloxy)-2-hydroxymethyl]-1,3,5,6-tetramethylene-pyridines by action of trifluoroacetic acid leads to 1,2,6,7,8,9-hexahydro-1-azabenzonaphtho[2,1-a]azepine-2-carboxylic acid trifluoromethyl ester.

1-[2-[(adamantan1-yl)-1,2,6,6-tetramethyl-1-azabicycle[3.3.l]non-3-ene]-2-oxo]ethyl]-1,4,4,6-tetraphenylnicotinium bromide was synthesized and its crystal structure was determined by X-ray diffraction analysis.
we have developed a new approach for the preparation of 1-azabi- cyclo[3.3.l]non-3-ene derivatives with an adamantane fragment in the molecule.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the carbocationic cyclization of 1-[1-(adamantan-1-yloxycarbonyloxy)-ethyl]pyridinium bromide is accompanied by the Wagner-Meerwein rearrangement of the carbocation with the formation of the 3-oxa-1,2-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]oct-5-enium cation, which is then converted to 1-azaspiro[4.5]decane.
the reaction of the title compounds with trifluoromethylsulfonic acid proceeds in a manner similar to that of 1-oxoethylpyridines.
the homoadamantan-2-yl fragment is a new structural element of aza- and azahomo-annelated systems.
